name: Quantitative Finance Developer
description: Build high-frequency trading systems, risk engines, and financial models. Optimize for microsecond latency and handle market data feeds.
example_snippet:
program OrderBook:
    shape Order holds:
        Price as fractional number
        Quantity as whole number
        Side as text
    end shape

    keep Bids as Order with values nothing and nothing and nothing

    action add_bid takes Price as fractional number, Qty as whole number produces nothing:
        keep NewOrder as Order with Price and Qty and "buy"
        # Add to sorted order book
        print the text "Bid added: " and Price and " x " and Qty and newline
    end action

    call add_bid with 100.5 and 500
    call add_bid with 100.25 and 300
end program
